subject: "Sticky" brew-rapache files, possible URL routing issue

messages.author: 45c4e745ee4a7f76
messages.subject: "Sticky" brew-rapache files, possible URL routing issue
parts:
I am seeing an issue with URL routing under rApache for pages that
include brew code. Effectively rhtml pages are "sticky" until the
apache server is restarted. No errors are generated in the logs.
RApacheInfo runs correctly.

The example below uses brew 1.0-6 rApache 1.1.16, prototype.js 1.7
running on Mac OSX 10.7.3 server containing Apache 2.2.21.

My configuration follows a suggestion from the mailing list to
configure Apache to recognize .rhtml extension as per Jeffrey Horner's
post of Oct 4 2010, 1:31 pm

your apache config:
<Directory /dir>
<FilesMatch "\.rhtml$">
SetHandler r-script
RHandler brew::brew
</FilesMatch>
</Directory>

Create three simple test files with source listed below at the bottom
of this message:
html file listing links: main.html
two linked rhtml files: first_page.rhtml and second_page.html

Each of the latter two files contains a simple pair of boxes for
entering a couple of dates and a chart button which for purposes of
this discussion can be considered a dummy action.

Enable the web server. Go to the main.html file web server link:

http://<web server>/tests/main.html

Navigate to the First linked rhtml page. You should see the title:
First page results.
Go back to main.html
Navigate to the Second linked rhtml page. You should see the title:
Second page results, but what I see is a reload of the First linked
page entitled First page results.

Shutdown and restart the web server. Go to the main page and then
navigate to the second link. Note the title. Return to the main page.
Go to the first link. This time the second link's title sticks even
when navigating to the first page, effectively the mirror behavior of
the first case.

Reseting the browser cache makes no difference. The problem is server
side (multiple machines targetting the same URL produce the same
result).

Note also it is browser independent, since curl commands produce the
same results.

It leads to other complications in rendering brew pages including
duplicate javascript insertions.

Note that if main.html is instead named with an .rhtml extension but
contains either no brew code, or a trivial snippet, the links do not
work properly (the browser switches to the right URL, but the page is
not accessible).

If the "chart" javascript buttons are enabled the stickiness described
here causes the previous page to be appended to the original page, but
I believe that if I can fix the problem described here, that issue
should be more easily isolated.

Is this a URL routing problem inside rApache?

Paul

Here's the simple code to reproduce the problem.

main.html
================================================================================
<!DOCTYPE html PUBLIC "-//W3C//DTD XHTML 1.0 Transitional//EN" "http://
www.w3.org/TR/xhtml1/DTD/xhtml1-transitional.dtd">
<!--test cover page.-->
<html>
<head>
<title>An HTML page of links to brew pages</title>
<link rel="stylesheet" type="text/css" href="../css/bt.css" />
<script src="../javascript/prototype.js" type="text/javascript"></
script>
<script src="../javascript/jscript.js" type="text/javascript"></
script>
</head>

<body>
<h1>Links</h1>

<ul>
<li><a href="first_page.rhtml">First linked rhtml page</a></li>
<li><a href="second_page.rhtml">Second linked rhtml page</a></li>
</ul>

<br>
<hr>
<br>
<div id="tools" class="clearfix">
<label>This web site uses the following software
tools:</label>
<a href="http://apple.com/macosx/server">OS X Lion Server
10.7.3</a><br>
<a href="http://projects.apache.org/projects/
http_server.html">Apache 2.2.21</a><br>
<a href="http://prototypejs.org">prototype.js 1.7</a><br>
<a href="http://biostat.mc.vanderbilt.edu/rapache/">RApache
1.1.16</a><br>
<a href="http://www.rforge.net/brew/">brew 1.0-6</a><br>

</div><!--end of tools-->
</body>
</html>

================================================================================

<link rel="stylesheet" type="text/css" href="../css/bt.css" />

script>
<script src="../javascript/bt.js" type="text/javascript"></script>

<body>

<br>

name="end" value="<%=endDate%>"></input></div>

Jeff,

Thanks for the reply.

It was my editing error regarding the bt.js vs. jscript.js is an artifact of trying to simplify the actual program to just the code that causes issues. The bt.js was intended to read jscript.js

But in the minimalist spirit of your reply, let us remove all references to javascript and css stylesheets entirely, since the problem independent of them. This means both the lines your referenced as well as the forms and Click action button as well as the css link. Moreover let's remove all database queries as well. Basically that leaves just some brew declaration code and rhtml extensions on the filenames. The pared down files are amended below. 

Again, it appears that going back and forth between two rhtml pages via an html page is "sticky" even if I restart the web server and clear any browser cache or use curl.

This seems about as trivial as I can make things, to the point where I would not be surprised that I am just code-blind from staring at it for too long and the problem is obvious to others.

Paul
